title: Biblical Meditation
definition: Biblical Meditation is the prayerful dwelling on God's Word so truth shapes the mind, heart, worship, and obedience.
summary: Biblical Meditation is the prayerful pondering of God's Word so that truth sinks into the heart and shapes obedience.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the living Word to whom Scripture points and through whom believers receive wisdom and life.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Biblical meditation is the prayerful dwelling on God's Word so truth sinks into the heart. Scripture presents meditation as filling the mind with what God has said, not emptying it into vague spirituality.

Meditation slows the believer down. It turns reading into reflection, reflection into prayer, and prayer into obedience.

Jesus is the living Word to whom Scripture points. Meditation on Scripture should lead to deeper trust in Him and clearer obedience to Him.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because hurried Scripture intake can leave truth on the surface. Biblical meditation fights distraction, anxiety, forgetfulness, and shallow discipleship by returning the heart again and again to God's voice.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Choose a verse or passage and carry it through the day. Ask what it reveals about God, what it corrects in you, how it points to Christ, and what obedience should follow.
